name: Magic Summon
doc: Magic Summon (Sphinxara's attack): the master and the main task - a circle layout at the target's feet, the target warped away on screen as its colour fades, a summon layout at it, the screen flash in its colours, the sound. Its tasks are the port's code (FFNx mag283_magic_summon.cpp) run on the program's memory (its pool and packet arenas in the magic buffer).

copy.doc: Where this effect's copy is in FF8_EN.exe: the program stands in for these functions.

module.doc: The port module whose code runs: its memory [from, + size) - in a copy, a block of its own.

exe_data.doc: The exe data the effect uses (@key in its values).

director.doc: The port's file loader, setup and root (they start its tasks)

parts.title: Director
parts.doc: The main task's timeline: the sound, its end; the screen flash and its colours; the texture and the camera

parts.title: Circle
parts.doc: Layout A at the target's feet, its texture scrolling

parts.title: Warp
parts.doc: The target redrawn warped away from its middle on screen, its colour fading (not a parameter: the warp's tables are code)

parts.title: Summon
parts.doc: Layout B at the target, from the warp's start

groups.label: Screen flash
groups.doc: Its rise and fall (black), its level between them in the colours

params.label: Sound
params.doc: At the main task's sound tick

params.label: Sound tick
params.doc: The sound at this tick of the main task

params.label: End tick
params.doc: The main task's ticks (layout A plays until then; the flash colours span them)

params.label: Level
params.doc: The screen flash's level between its rise and its fall (4096 = full), in the colours

params.label: Rise ticks
params.doc: It first rises over this many ticks, black (the tick x the step)

params.label: Fall ticks
params.doc: It falls over the last ticks, black ((the end - the tick) x the step)

params.label: Flash colours
params.doc: The colours the flash goes through over the main task: 8 x (red, green, blue, -), blended from each to the next (32 bytes)

params.label: Texture file
params.doc: The texture file its loader reads from the magic folder (a name of at most 31 letters)

params.label: Camera track
params.doc: The camera track its setup plays (any length: its offsets are its own)

params.label: Scroll
params.doc: Its object 1's texture scrolls this much a tick (16 ticks a cycle; 0: none)

params.label: Layout A
params.doc: The prim-model layout at the target's feet (its models' animation), scaled by the target's size

params.label: Tick
params.doc: From this tick the target is warped away (20 ticks: its colour fading out, redrawn pushed from its middle on screen) and layout B plays

params.label: Ticks
params.doc: Layout B plays this many ticks (the target is put back after the warp's 20)

params.label: Layout B
params.doc: The prim-model layout at the target (its models' animation), scaled by the target's size

not_editable.label: Warp weights
not_editable.doc: U16 [20][128]: the offset's weight by distance (4.12), per step

not_editable.label: Warp distance
not_editable.doc: U8 [128][128]: the distance of (|dy|, |dx|) (row 20 of the weights)
